findings.title: Unclear description and irrelevant banking data
findings.message: The short text "Ortsfesten Schutzzaun (h = 2,00 m)" is not sufficiently specific (no material, type, wind load class) and the long text contains banking details that are unrelated to the construction work, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires clear and exhaustive descriptions.
findings.suggestion: Specify fence type (e.g., steel mesh, DIN 1055‑1), material class, wind load class, and remove all banking information from the specification.

findings.title: Missing technical specifications for geotextile
findings.message: The position only states "Geotextil (b = 12 m) liefern und verlegen" without indicating the geotextile type, class (e.g., geotextile class A/B), tensile strength, or applicable norm (DIN 18130). This breaches the requirement for complete technical data per STLB‑Bau standard.
findings.suggestion: Add material designation, class, tensile strength, perforation size, and reference to the applicable norm.

findings.title: Missing disposal of removed geotextile
findings.message: The removal of geotextile is a special service according to VOB/C Abschnitt 4.2 (Entsorgung von Baustoffen). It is not listed as a separate position, thus constitutes an additional performance not covered by the contract (VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6).
findings.suggestion: Create a separate position for the disposal of removed geotextile, including transport and waste handling fees.

findings.title: Unclear scope of humus removal
findings.message: The phrase "Humus abschieben und andecken (Baufeldbreite bis 14 m)" lacks depth, target layer, and quality criteria (e.g., organic content). VOB/A § 7 requires a precise definition of the work.
findings.suggestion: Specify removal depth, target humus layer thickness, and acceptance criteria (e.g., organic matter < 5%).

findings.title: Inconsistent description and missing material reference
findings.message: The short text "wie vor, jedoch Rohrgrabenaushub HB 2 - Tone, Lehm," is ambiguous and the long text "[PERSON_033] Sand" contradicts the soil type, creating a conflict between the short and long description.
findings.suggestion: Clarify the soil type to be excavated (e.g., clayey silt) and remove contradictory references.

findings.title: Missing equipment specification for hand excavation
findings.message: No equipment or method is defined for "Handschachtung"; VOB/C requires specification of tools or manual labor standards.
findings.suggestion: State that excavation shall be performed with hand tools (e.g., spade, pick) according to DIN 18300‑2.

findings.title: Unclear soil improvement method
findings.message: The term "Bodenverbesserung durchführen" is vague; it does not specify the type of improvement (e.g., lime stabilization, compaction) nor the required standards (DIN 18300).
findings.suggestion: Define the improvement method, material, dosage, and reference the applicable norm.

findings.title: Unfair risk transfer for sampling material
findings.message: The clause forces the contractor to take on all liability for sampling and transport of [PERSON_093] material without specifying quality control responsibilities, which may be an unlawful risk shift under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a balanced risk allocation, e.g., shared responsibility for sampling quality and transport.

findings.title: Unit mismatch for frost protection layer
findings.message: The unit is given in cubic meters (m³) while the description "(t=0,30 m)" suggests a thickness; the volume calculation is unclear.
findings.suggestion: Provide both area (m²) and thickness (m) or calculate the volume explicitly.

findings.title: Missing description for unspecified items
findings.message: The short text is empty, making the position non‑identifiable, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands a clear description.
findings.suggestion: Insert a precise short and long text describing the item (e.g., "Steuerungseinheit für Drainage"), including material and performance data.

findings.title: Missing description for pipe length
findings.message: The position lacks any textual description, which is non‑compliant with VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and makes the scope ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Add a short text such as "PE‑HD Rohr DN 200, Länge 6 m, 2‑fach verlegt" and include material class.

findings.title: Missing description for cable installation
findings.message: No short or long text is provided, violating the requirement for clear specification (VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1).
findings.suggestion: Specify cable type, cross‑section, protective conduit, and installation depth.

findings.title: Missing technical data for branch shaft
findings.message: The short text "Abzweigschacht" lacks dimensions, material, and design criteria, which are required for a clear contract description (VOB/A § 7).
findings.suggestion: Add shaft diameter, depth, wall material (e.g., concrete C25/30), and any required fittings.

findings.title: Contractual penalty clause for delayed hydraulic excavator use
findings.message: The hint after position 7.1.80 imposes a €5,000 per day penalty for not using a hydraulic excavator early enough. Such a blanket penalty may be deemed unreasonable and thus ineffective under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Replace the fixed daily penalty with a proportionate liquidated damages clause linked to actual delay impact.
